name: 184. Normalized decision request on /v1/decisions (decisions-normalized)
description: Pins the normalized /v1/decisions body (PR #8181): input plus an ordered list of typed questions (predicate, choice, score), answered as an ordered list. Covers every question type including boolean choices and an unnamed question, text, structured and message inputs, the same body served by chat emulation, a stray state next to input being ignored (Typesafe receives the input as its state), and the rejection of an image sent to a Typesafe model, which cannot read it. The deprecated map form stays covered by folders 106-108.
